 Home / News / ‘Beauty and the Beast’ Star Emma Watson Resurfaces at Armani’s Star-Packed Chateau Marmont Bash
 By Hrvoje Milakovic 
 Published on October 20, 2026 October 20, 2026 
 0 Comments 
 Depositphotos 
 Our Editorial Policy 
 Share: 
 Every autumn, Hollywood trades the red carpet for a different kind of spotlight, one lit by film history instead of box office. The Academy Museum Gala has become a reliably starry affair, often described as the West Coast rival to New York’s Met Gala. This year’s edition delivered, and one late arrival turned heads.
 The sixth annual gala took place on Saturday, October 17, in Los Angeles, raising more than $14 million for the museum’s exhibitions, education initiatives and public programs. John Carpenter received the Luminary Award, Charlize Theron the Icon Award and Colman Domingo the Vantage Award. Jamie Lee Curtis took the stage to spotlight the museum’s newest exhibition, ‘The Horror Show’.
 When the speeches ended, the party moved to Chateau Marmont. Emma Watson made a rare appearance at Giorgio Armani’s exclusive Academy Museum Gala after-party. The 36-year-old ‘Harry Potter’ actress made a quick dash into the hotel on Saturday night, wearing black.
 Emma Watson looks gorgeous as she makes a rare appearance at the Academy Museum Gala after-party!
Photos: Backgrid https://t.co/SfQT1BPvBa
— JustJared.com (@JustJared) October 19, 2026 
 Watson has stepped back from the spotlight in recent years, though she has made clear in interviews that this was about pacing her life, not retiring from acting. Her last major film was ‘Little Women’ in 2019, and she directed a short for Prada’s Prada Paradoxe fragrance campaign in 2022. That’s why each public outing tends to feel like an event.
 This one fits into a more social stretch for her. In September, she attended the opening night gala for George Lucas and Mellody Hobson’s Lucas Museum of Narrative Art in Los Angeles. Earlier this year, her first event of 2026 was W magazine and Dior’s pre-Oscar dinner at Mr Chow in Beverly Hills, where she was photographed with Macaulay Culkin, Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Tracee Ellis Ross.
 Emma Watson arriving at Giorgio Armani’s party at Chateau Marmont [October 18, 2026]
All photos at https://t.co/BCyluRCRpU
#emmawatson https://t.co/CQPsRlNDcn
— 🕸🍂 Emma Watson Updates 🍂🕸 (@EmWatsonUpdates) October 19, 2026 
 The main event was stacked with industry heavyweights. The host committee included Questlove, Judd Apatow, Teyana Taylor, Ludwig Göransson, Seth Rogen and Demi Moore, while Steven Spielberg, Kate Capshaw and Robert Rodriguez served as co-chairs. Sigourney Weaver presented Theron with her award, and Rodriguez presented Carpenter, the filmmaker behind ‘Halloween’.
 Dinner was prepared by guest chef Antonia Lofaso and Wolfgang Puck Catering, and the museum’s president, Amy Homma, opened the program with a look back at its first five years. The night also marked a fundraising jump from the previous year, when the gala raised over $12 million.
 Emma Watson getting ready for the Academy Museum Gala, October 18 2026 ✨ https://t.co/vu6yhWbSdP
— best of emma watson (@emmawfiles) October 19, 2026 
 Giorgio Armani’s after-party at Chateau Marmont is now an annual tradition. The hotel’s intimate atmosphere makes it a natural spot for the industry’s after-hours crowd, and Watson’s cameo adds to the buzz. Photographers caught her walking into the hotel before she vanished inside.
 Her look matched the mood of her recent outings. Across her recent appearances, Watson has stuck to a dark, elegant palette, leaning into thoughtful, sustainable choices. She often keeps the styling understated, letting the occasion speak for itself.
 RELATED: 
 ‘Little Women’ Star Emma Watson’s Makeup Artist Drops a Set of Glowing Close-Ups, and Hermione Has Never Looked Quite Like This 
 The fan reaction has been predictable. Watson’s appearances have become rare enough that each one gets treated like a headline, and this gala sighting is no exception. A viral video from a music festival earlier this year showed her dancing to Chappell Roan’s ‘Hot to Go!’, which drew plenty of surprised comments online.
 She has also surfaced in other settings. Earlier this summer, she was spotted at the Royal Foundation’s United for Wildlife business forum in London alongside Prince William and Benedict Cumberbatch. Together, these outings suggest a star who shows up on her own terms.
 For fans hoping for a full return, there’s no official announcement. Fan pages have long speculated about a reunion with director Greta Gerwig, who directed her in ‘Little Women’, but nothing has been confirmed. Watson herself has said she intends to return to acting in the future, though not on a set timeline.
 For now, the Chateau Marmont moment is a reminder that she remains one of Hollywood’s most closely watched figures, even when she’s barely there. A quick dash through the door was enough to start the conversation.
 Would You Like to See Emma Watson Return to Acting? 
 Absolutely! I’d love to see her in a new movie soon. 
 A reunion with Greta Gerwig — I’d love to see them work together again. 
 A return to a major franchise — Bring on another iconic role! 
 Something completely different — I’m curious to see her explore new genres. 
 I respect her privacy — She should take all the time she needs. 
 I’m more interested in her fashion and public appearances than her acting career.
